literal_meaning: মাথা ঘুরে যাওয়া (head spinning or whirling)
figurative_meaning_en: Similar to going mad or feeling dizzy and confused
example_sentences_in_bangla: খবর শুনে আমার মাথা ঘুরে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: His head is spinning due to the heat.
My head spun upon hearing the news.
note: Commonly used to describe both physical dizziness and mental disorientation in Bengali culture.
